headline: Accounts Chamber on the Risk of Incomplete Attraction of External Loans in 2027
summary: The Accounts Chamber flagged low implementation of this year's external borrowing plan and a large share of external loans in financing the 2027 budget deficit, raising the risk of shortfalls.
why: External borrowing shortfalls can force the government to adjust spending or seek other financing, which matters for sovereign credit assessments.
